tests.title: parses positional and named mode and seed options and refuses everything else with exact messages
declares every capability false, negotiates the input format unchanged and leaves counts, packets and reservations alone
returns every input frame unchanged with its own planes, for every mode, format, channel count and frame split
keeps the chain allocation limits and observes cancellation
matches native framecrc for every aperms mode and seed on u8 s16 s32 f32 f64 mono and stereo, alone and chained
writes native-identical WAV and raw PCM files from WAV and raw inputs
fails explicitly before output for native errors and the unseeded random mode native accepts

nativeComparisons.details: framecrc bytes: 5 raw formats (u8,s16le,s32le,f32le,f64le) x 1-2 channels x 8 mode forms (default,none,ro,rw,toggle,random seeds 0/7/4294967295) x 5 chains (alone, +volume=0.5, asetnsamples=5 before, +apad=pad_len=3, toggle+mode+asetnsamples=5+apad=pad_len=3), -cpuflags 0; WAV and raw output file bytes: 5 formats x 1-2 channels x raw/WAV input x 4 modes x 3 chains x 2 containers; native exit status for 10 option refusals plus resampling after aperms (native 0, ours refused).

unsupported: mode=random without an explicit seed or with seed=-1 (native succeeds via av_get_random_seed; intentional refusal)
numeric or expression mode values (native accepts, e.g. mode=1)
FLAC input (refused before decoding; flacInput not declared)
automatic sample-rate conversion across the step (rateConversion false)
frame writability itself (frames carry no permission flag)

notes: No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
Setup durations: submodule update 69s, npm ci 8s, reference:build 205s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 60s, baseline tests/unit 88s, differential suite ~9s.
Baseline unit failures are the expected FLAC artifact tests (downloads.xiph.org blocked) and 10 resample-checkpoint golden digests recorded on macOS arm64.
Like anull, aperms omits formats() ('all') because output samples equal input samples; capabilities are all false as specified, so unlike anull it refuses resampling and FLAC input.
No float-sensitive cases: data is unaffected by every mode; volume=0.5 runs with -cpuflags 0 on both sides.
